written_before: any validation or confirmatory Pong rescue result existed
coordination: Another session was concurrently running the v1.3 multitask screen in the main working tree. By user decision, this sprint freezes from that session's completed Pong development screen rather than rerunning it, and runs in a separate git worktree so no files under that session's running jobs are touched.

phase1_representation_diagnostic.source: artifacts/v13/representation-pong.json (produced by the concurrent v1.3 session on development seeds)
phase1_representation_diagnostic.interpretation: Nonlinear decoding of the exact heuristic action stays far below 0.80 at every tick count, so by the sprint rule this is a poor-decoding case; integration time helps monotonically. The reward learner nevertheless reached 0.83 at 8 ticks, so exact heuristic-action imitation is a stricter target than the coarse intercept information the policy needs.

phase2_screen.source: runs/v13-dev/mlp_screen/mlp_screen-pong-c*-s{0,1} (16 configs x 2 dev seeds, screen_train/screen_eval purposes)
phase2_screen.learner: NumPy MLP actor-critic (hidden 128, tanh) + clipped PPO + GAE, Adam, grad-norm clip 0.5
phase2_screen.result: every ticks=8 config 0.742-0.829; every ticks=4 config 0.486-0.654
phase2_screen.selection_rule: highest two-seed mean; runner-up configs c02 0.812, c07 0.808 make the choice insensitive to screening noise

validation_gate_before_freeze.seeds: dev seeds 0,1,2 under validate_train / validate_eval purposes (never screen, never confirmatory)
pass_if: every seed: greedy state probe uses more than one action
validation_gate_before_freeze.if_fail: do not freeze c03; escalate per ladder (12 ticks, then GRU) on development seeds only

per_seed_all_required: after > before (untrained frozen policy, same seeds)
greedy state probe uses more than one action (no constant-action collapse)
study_level_required: every biological seed passes all per-seed components
